err.auth_state: Action not allowed in the current state

err.bad_phone: Enter the phone in international format
err.checkpoint_failed: Durable checkpoint failed — temp files kept for recovery.
err.code_expired: The code expired, request a new one
err.cooldown: Please wait before requesting a new code

err.permanent: Permanent error, will not retry. Check the link or permissions.
err.reauth: Session expired. Please sign in again.
err.scan_limit: Latest mode needs a positive count
err.scan_message_id: Message mode needs a positive message id, or paste a direct message link
err.scan_range_ids: Range mode needs a start id and an end id
err.scan_range_invalid: Invalid message range: the end cannot precede the start

err.session_missing: Local Telegram session file is missing.
err.session_vault_invalid: Saved Telegram session data is invalid or incomplete.
err.session_not_authorized: Telegram must finish signing in before saving to Drive.
err.tg_connect_failed: Could not reach Telegram servers. Check your internet connection and try again.
err.tg_phone_flood: Telegram temporarily limited this number after too many attempts — wait a few hours and try again
err.tg_phone_invalid: Telegram rejected the phone number — check the international format and resend
err.verify_failed: Drive verification of the uploaded file failed.

form.upload_client_json: Upload OAuth JSON from Google Cloud

msg.share_warning: Warning: public sharing exposes the UI to everyone.

settings.concurrency.title: Parallel workers
msg.recovery_corrupt: Checkpoint is corrupt — no data was changed
analyze.empty: No results yet — analyze a link first
err.selection_range_invalid: Invalid selection range — enter positive start/end IDs and the end must not precede the start
err.selection_range_too_large: Selection range too large — the cap is 1000 messages
msg.no_selection: No selection — every pending queue row will start
msg.incomplete_cleared: Incomplete queue rows were cleared. Uploaded Drive files were not touched.

sel.hint: Click any table row to toggle its selection manually
zone.connection.hint: Live connection status and Telegram/Drive sign-in. A «connected» chip appears only after a real connection succeeds.
zone.settings_export.hint: Configure concurrency, language and theme, recovery and checkpoints, then build the package / Colab cells.
flow.step1.title: Connect
flow.step1.hint: Sign in to Telegram, link Google Drive, then pick the destination folder. The next step stays hidden until all three are really done.
flow.step2.title: Analyze link
flow.step2.hint: Paste a message or channel link, choose the scope, then analyze. Nothing is queued in this step.
flow.step3.title: Filter and select
flow.step3.hint: Filter the results, then select files. The summary shows count, size and destination folder before any transfer.
flow.step4.title: Transfer queue
flow.step4.hint: Move the selected files into the queue, review it, then start. Start stays disabled without items and a destination folder.
flow.step5.title: Monitor
flow.step5.hint: Live progress, retry failed, per-item controls and redacted logs.
warn.concurrency_high: Warning: more than 8 workers can exhaust Colab RAM or trigger Telegram FloodWait. Allowed, but at your own risk.
